name: Serbia

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 6567783 inhabitants, recorded as 6.568 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Still an opening estimate. Attempted on 2026-07-27 in the transversal venues pass and left unchanged, because the candidate list was established and the test was not. Read at source, in the survey of puppetry on the territory of present-day Serbia: nine professional houses operating today — Pozorište mladih in Novi Sad, founded 1931 and the first professional children's theatre in the country; Dečje pozorište Subotica, 1934, playing in Serbian, Croatian and Hungarian; Pozorište lutaka „Pinokio” in Zemun, 1972; Malo pozorište „Duško Radović” in Belgrade, 1948, which began as the puppet theatre of the Republic; Pozorište za decu i mlade in Kragujevac, 1994; the puppet stage of the Narodno pozorište „Toša Jovanović” in Zrenjanin, 1952, playing in Serbian and Hungarian; Pozorište „Boško Buha” in Belgrade, 1950; Pozorište lutaka Niš; and Pozorištance Puž, 1977. What the survey does not give is who founds or funds any of them, and the denominator turns on exactly that. Two of the nine are also doubtful on vocation rather than on backing — Boško Buha is a children's and youth theatre, Pozorištance Puž a small house — and each would have to be read the way Hungary's Kolibri was. No value produced: a list of names is not a count.

Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. One establishment retained: the Academy of Arts in Novi Sad, part of the state University of Novi Sad. Criterion read at source: a two-year master's programme in puppetry within the department of dramatic arts; puppetry named in the programme title; public institution. The previous value of 0.5 was the midpoint of an estimated range, not an observation. Upper bound at 2: the source claims a national first, but that claim covers the complete master's programme, not the whole field. It does not rule out an undergraduate stream elsewhere in Serbia and is not enough to close the range.

establishments.name: Akademija umetnosti (Univerzitet u Novom Sadu)
establishments.description: The arts academy of the state University of Novi Sad. Its puppetry master's is described by the academy as the first complete programme of its kind in the country.

Find the annual report of at least one organisation in the country.

venues: Serbia has its candidate list from the 2026-07-27 pass — nine professional houses, named in the reasoning with their founding years. What is missing is the founding authority for each. The route not yet tried is the Geosrbija geoportal, which the government presents as the fullest register of cultural institutions in the country, and which would give status and coordinates together.

venues: two of the nine need the Kolibri test rather than a funding check — Pozorište „Boško Buha” and Pozorištance Puž are not obviously puppetry units. Zrenjanin is the opposite case and is already a named puppet stage inside a drama theatre, so it would enter as a stage.
